class.name: BehaviorTreeCooldown
class.brief_description: Blocks repeating a successful child task until its cooldown expires.
class.description: After the child returns [constant BehaviorTreeTask.SUCCESS], this decorator stores a countdown in the current runner's execution memory and returns success. Subsequent evaluations during the cooldown return [constant BehaviorTreeTask.FAILURE] without running the child. The cooldown advances by the delta of evaluations of this decorator; after it expires, child execution is allowed again. [constant BehaviorTreeTask.RUNNING] does not start a cooldown, and failed children do not start one. This is a branch-scoped policy: [method BehaviorTreeRunner.reset] or a parent that clears the branch (such as a preempting reactive selector) also clears the cooldown. For persistent event cooldowns independent of tree restarts, use [AIActionCooldowns] instead. A missing child fails safely.

method.name: set_duration
method.description: Sets the finite nonnegative cooldown duration in simulated seconds. A zero duration disables throttling.
